content: Test suite verifies floor triangle index building, memory bounds (indices >100k, packed bytes <3MB), acceleration raycasting, and projection coverage optimization in both fixed-first and joint-pair modes. Fixed mode uses origin [2.5, 1.6, 2.5]; both modes produce 256 samples, >2 candidates, finite origins, origin separation >=4, and reachableCoverage >= combinedCoverage.

evidence.excerpt: const fixed = optimizeProjectionCoverage({ mode: 'fixed-first', scene, firstOrigin: [2.5, 1.6, 2.5], options });
const joint = optimizeProjectionCoverage({ mode: 'joint-pair', scene, options });

items.text: Floor geometry test: indices > 100k triangles, packed memory < 3MB; acceleration distance test uses reference point [11, 1.6, 11]; projection coverage tested in fixed-first (firstOrigin [2.5, 1.6, 2.5]) and joint-pair modes with 256 samples, >2 candidates, finite origins, and minimum origin separation of 4.
